blocks.text: Mercaptans are used to give odour to natural gas. Some thiols have pleasant odours on high dilution, for example, thioterpineol is the key ingredient in the aroma of grapefruit. cis-glabanum oxathiane is a fragrant compound. It is used in fine fragrances, soaps, shampoos and shower gels. Many naturally occurring odorants are produced synthetically and also applied as flavouring agents.
